prompt:
Original bold mid-century horror-cartoon colouring-book ink art for adults: clean white paper, thick varied black contours, rounded expressive shape language and crisp closed colourable forms. Medium-detail retro graphic styling with roomy open areas, selective simple patterning, controlled spot-black shadows and sparse screen-print-like texture marks. Playful, nostalgic and lightly macabre mood; no colour, gradients, hatching, grey wash, fine-line rendering or realistic shading. High-contrast, home-printable monochrome line work.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Bold mid-century horror-cartoon colouring-book line art with a playful retro roadside sensibility.; line weight: Thick to very thick black outlines, with deliberate weight variation for emphasis; never fine line.; line quality: Smooth, confident, rounded ink contours with slightly bouncy hand-drawn energy; crisp closed shapes for easy colouring.; detail level: Medium detail: large, satisfying colourable shapes supported by selective decorative accents, simple patterns and readable background props; avoid dense micro-detail.; character language: Expressive, rounded cartoon anatomy with oversized features, theatrical silhouettes and mischievous adult-comedy expressions; recognisable through bold shape language rather than realism.; background density: Moderately populated scene dressing that frames the main action without filling every gap; preserve generous white areas and clear colour zones.; composition: Clear central focal hierarchy, bold foreground silhouettes and simple layered depth. Use open resting areas around focal forms, with secondary details arranged as readable framing rather than visual clutter.; palette: Pure black ink on clean white paper; artwork must remain entirely colourer-led, with no pre-coloured fills.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No realistic rendering, gradients or hatching. Use occasional solid black shadow masses, simple spot blacks and sparse graphic texture marks only where they strengthen contrast.; texture: Clean printable ink finish with restrained retro screen-print flavour suggested through sparse graphic marks, never dense noise.; mood: Cheeky, nostalgic, mischievous and lightly macabre; humorous spooky escapism for adults..

PAGE 1 of "Midnight Monster Diner Colouring Book" (cover): Illustrated colouring-book cover: eccentric monster lineup at a retro all-night roadside diner counter, centred on an enormous haunted milkshake with ghost-shaped whipped cream, crooked straw and cherry eyeball; vampire, cyclops, werewolf and elegant ghost patrons; moon and diner sign framing the composition; exact title text “MIDNIGHT MONSTER DINER” in chunky retro lettering, small subtitle “COLOURING BOOK”.

PAGE DETAIL: A roadside diner counter is packed with a vampire, a one-eyed cyclops, a shaggy werewolf and a glamorous ghost, all facing an enormous haunted milkshake with a crooked straw, whipped-cream ghost and cherry eyeball. A crescent moon, diner sign and small stars frame the scene. Chunky arched title lettering reads “MIDNIGHT MONSTER DINER”; a small subtitle reads “COLOURING BOOK”. Notes: Verify title spelling exactly. Keep the cover as uncoloured line art despite its illustrated-cover role. Ensure the milkshake is the clear focal point and all character silhouettes remain distinct.

BOOK CONSISTENCY: This is page 1 of 21 in one colouring book whose style the owner approved from pages 2, 3, 21. Draw it in exactly that approved style: the same line weight and line quality, the same level of detail and colouring difficulty, the same visual density, border treatment and page margins, the same black-and-white treatment and the same character designs where characters appear. Do not restyle this page.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour. Single-sided portrait colouring pages with generous colourable spaces, robust contours and practical breathing room for A4 and US Letter home printing. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any copied or recognisable characters, logos, typography, compositions or trade dress from existing horror, cartoon or diner brands; Fine-line, fragile, faint or sketchy outlines; Photorealism, realistic anatomy, cinematic rendering or realistic shading; Dense hatching, gradients, grey washes or pre-coloured artwork; Overcrowded pages, tiny colour cells, tangled overlaps or unreadable focal points; Excessive solid-black coverage that wastes home-printer ink; Childish babyish styling; retain witty adult humour; Misspelled, distorted or illegible text.
